abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

verification.notes: Fully encoded from user-provided in-game Argus screenshots dated 2026-08-02. Recommendation tags are derived from the source-backed kit.

abilities.name: Mosh Pit
abilities.description: Narbash gains 2.0/2.5/3.0/3.5/4.0/4.5/5.0/5.5/6.0/6.5/7.0/7.5/8.0/8.5/9.0/9.5/10.0/10.5 (+0.5 per level) Physical Power, Physical Armor and Magical Armor for each nearby Allied or Enemy Hero within a 1700u radius.

abilities.name: March!
abilities.description: Bellow out a rallying war cry, granting Narbash an empowered version of Song of My People for himself and his nearby Allies for 3.0/3.3/3.5/3.8/4.0s. Speed: Gain 15.0/17.5/20.0/22.5/25.0% (+4.5% magical power) Movement Speed. Healing: Gain 15.0/20.0/25.0/30.0/35.0 (+20% magical power) Health Regeneration.

abilities.name: Song Of My People
abilities.description: Toggle: Play a soothing beat, granting Narbash and his Allies additional Speed or Healing. Healing Aura: Grants 1.5/2.5/3.5/4.5/5.5 (+2% magical power) Health Regeneration. Speed Aura: Grants 4.5/5.5/6.5/7.5/8.5% (+3% haste) Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Thunk
abilities.description: Toss a drumstick that deals 95.0/140.0/185.0/230.0/275.0 (+85% magical power)(+120% magical power) magical damage in a tiny area of effect, Knocking Back and Stunning the Enemies hit for 1.1/1.1/1.2/1.3/1.3s.

abilities.name: Crash Bang Boom!
abilities.description: Narbash Slows himself by 30% and Channels a drum solo for 3s. Nearby Enemies receive 5.0/7.5/10.0 (+3% magical power)(+5% physical power) magical damage per hit and are Slowed by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. Enemies afflicted with maximum Slow stacks become Mesmerized instead. The final hit deals 80.0/150.0/220.0 (+70% magical power)(+100% physical power) magical damage, Knocking Up all Enemies and Stunning them for 0.5s.

augments.name: War Anthem
augments.description: Narbash's Abilities heal for 50% less. Healing Aura grants +5.0/7.0/9.0/11.0/13.0 Physical Power. March's Heal also grants +14.0/23.0/32.0/41.0/50.0 Physical Power.

augments.name: Thonk
augments.description: Thunk falls to the floor if it hits an Enemy. If Narbash picks it up he refunds 35% of its Cooldown and 50% of its Mana Cost.

augments.name: Percussive Tear
augments.description: Each hit of Crash Bang Boom! Shreds 2.5% Armors for 3s.
